title: Delta CEO says FAA ground stop will cost “tens of millions of dollars”
summary:
Delta CEO Ed Bastian says Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop will cost “tens of millions of dollars.”

On Fortune Daily with Ellie Austin, Bastian explained what went wrong and what needs to change before the holiday travel rush.

title: SpaceX just caught a spaceship out of the sky
summary: SpaceX's Ship 42 circled the Earth 14 times, then came back 22.5 hours later and was caught mid-air by the same tower it launched from, the first catch of a spaceship returning from orbit. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen walks through the flight and why it matters for Starlink, AI satellites and SpaceX's compute business.

title: Delta CEO: Most airlines touting Starlink “haven’t even started yet”
summary:
“This is about the total experience, and customers are not choosing airlines based on the Wi-Fi.”

At the F500 Innovation Forum, Delta CEO Ed Bastian told Alyson Shontell that the airline helped Elon Musk’s satellite Wi-Fi “get started in aviation,” but the two sides “just couldn’t come to agreement on a business model.”
